items.title: one-kilometer garden ring shapes carlo ratti associati’s ‘hospital of the future’
items.titleZh: 一公里长的花园环形，塑造了卡洛·拉蒂·阿索恰蒂的“未来医院”
items.summary: the new campus extends the radial hospital plan of brescia, italy with glazed wings and a garden-filled hybrid timber structure.
items.summaryZh: 新校区延伸了意大利布雷西亚放射状医院布局，采用了玻璃翼楼和花园式混合木结构。

items.title: kengo kuma on why craftsmanship remains architecture’s connection to place
items.titleZh: 隈研吾谈为何工艺依然是建筑与场所的联系
items.summary: the japanese architect reflects on local materials, evolving traditions, and the role craftsmanship continues to play in an increasingly technological world.
items.summaryZh: 这位日本建筑师反思了本地材料、不断演变的传统，以及工艺在日益科技化世界中持续发挥的作用。

items.title: BIG completes dymak’s HQ as a full-scale showcase of natural materials in denmark
items.titleZh: BIG将DYMAK总部完善为丹麦天然材料的全方位展示平台
items.summary: timber, clay, cork, and eelgrass shape a workplace where material performance is experienced through everyday use.
items.summaryZh: 木材、粘土、软木和海草塑造了一个通过日常使用体验材料性能的工作场所。

items.title: SpaceDNA arranges split levels of Indian home around rust-orange staircase
items.titleZh: SpaceDNA将印度人住宅的分层布局围绕锈橙色楼梯展开
items.summary: Perforated steel screens filter light into this multi-generational house in Coimbatore, India, which architecture studio SpaceDNA completed with an oxide-coated staircase that steps around a triple-height void.
items.summaryZh: 穿孔钢板过滤光线，进入这座位于印度科印拜陀的多代同堂住宅，建筑事务所SpaceDNA通过覆盖氧化物的楼梯完成，楼梯环绕三层高空洞。

items.title: MAD adds trio of "cloud buildings" to Tencent headquarters in Shenzhen
items.titleZh: MAD在深圳腾讯总部新增三座“云层建筑”
items.summary: Three interconnected curved volumes and two office towers comprise the Tengyun Center in Shenzhen, China, which has been completed by architecture studio MAD for technology company Tencent.
items.summaryZh: 位于中国深圳的腾云中心由三个相互连接的弧形体量和两座办公楼组成，由建筑事务所MAD为腾讯科技公司完成。

items.title: monolithic brick volumes wrap weekend house around a series of courtyards in argentina
items.titleZh: 巨大的砖砌体量将周末别墅环绕在阿根廷一系列庭院之间
items.summary: modular construction is adapted to traditional brick craftsmanship.
items.summaryZh: 模块化建筑采用传统砖砌工艺。

items.title: Davidson Prize winner proposes reusing buses as mobile playgrounds
items.titleZh: 戴维森奖得主提议将公交车再利用为流动游乐场
items.summary: Multidisciplinary team RUA Studio has won this year's Davidson Prize with Playdeck, a concept design that envisions repurposing decommissioned buses into playscapes for people of all ages.
items.summaryZh: 多学科团队RUA Studio凭借Playdeck获得了今年的戴维森奖，该概念设计设想将退役的公交车改造成适合各年龄段游客的游乐景观。

items.title: designing for the senses: moving beyond the picture-perfect obsession to activate emotion
items.titleZh: 为感官设计：超越完美无瑕的痴迷，激发情感
items.summary: the fourth episode of the room for dreams podcast moves past the picture-perfect obsession to explore the drama and imperfection of spatial memory.
items.summaryZh: 《梦之室》播客第四集超越了完美无瑕的痴迷，探讨了空间记忆的戏剧性和不完美。

items.title: Sunken lightwells illuminate partially submerged London home by Stylus Architects
items.titleZh: 下沉式光井照亮了由Stylus Architects设计的部分淹没的伦敦住宅
items.summary: Local studio Stylus Architects has completed Green Lodge, a partially submerged family home in Roehampton Village, southwest London, where a series of sunken lightwells brings daylight into rooms set below ground.
items.summaryZh: 本地事务所Stylus Architects已完成位于伦敦西南部罗汉普顿村的Green Lodge，这是一座部分淹没的家庭住宅，一系列下沉的采光井为地下房间引入自然光。
